# AGENTS.md — mis-backend

<!-- Generated by mis-workspace ONBOARDING.md from the repo profile. This is now the repo's own contract, so maintain it here. -->

## Purpose

Laravel 12 API for the MIS project. It receives RFID card scans from the Arduino scanner firmware (`arduino-rfid-scanner`), records attendance, relays card UIDs to the admin UI for card→student assignment, and serves the admin SPA (`mis-frontend`) and the student/parent app (`mis-mobile`). The RFID flow is rebuilt identically to `enrollment/mis-be`. Generator output (`laravel/laravel` + `php artisan install:api`); staff auth, school years, students, employees, grade levels, programs, terms, sections enrollments, term rollover, and fee items, fee schedules, payment plans and discounts (billing) implemented.

## Ownership

Owner: a.baladon@qstrike.com. Part of the `mis` project — shared plans, rules and wiki live in the workspace and are linked here at `.claude/common/` and `.claude/diagrams/`.

## Local Contracts

- Stack: php / Laravel ^12.0 (Sanctum ^4.0) · DB: postgres (tests: SQLite `:memory:`)
- Layer chain (build order): migration → model → factory → request → resource? → controller → route → test
- Coding rules: `.claude/rules/rules-common.md`, `.claude/rules/rules-backend.md`. Both are binding.
- Implementation agent: `be-developer`. Auditor: `be-auditor`.
- Plans for this repo: `.claude/common/plans/active/<slug>/plan-be.md`
- Route groups: device routes at the `/api` root, public. Every admin route under `Route::prefix('mis')` → `/api/mis/...`, behind `auth:sanctum` + admin/registrar role middleware. Auth done (mis-1): `POST /api/mis/login` public; everything else in `/api/mis` behind `auth:sanctum` + `role:admin,registrar` (staff group), plus a `role:admin` group for admin-only routes.
- Scanner contract (frozen; identical to `enrollment/mis-be`, matches the firmware — change only together with a firmware change):
  - `POST /api/scan` — JSON `{"rfid"}` — attendance. Student by `rfid` (404 `{message}` if none); first scan of the day creates `student_attendances` `time_in` + `status=present`, later scans set `time_out`; uses the **active school year**. 200 `{student, attendance}`.
  - `POST /api/rfid/scan` — form `rfid=` — assignment relay. 403 `{status, message}` unless cache `rfid_channel_opened` is set (by `/api/mis/rfid/open`, 300 s); else broadcasts `AssignRfid` (`message` = UID) on public channel `rfid`.
  - UID = uppercase hex bytes joined by `:` (4, 7 or 10 bytes). Firmware sends no Accept header → the api group forces `Accept: application/json`.
  - `students.rfid`: string, nullable, unique.
- Staff auth endpoints (mis-1, `AuthController`): `POST /api/mis/login` JSON `{email, password}` → 200 `{token, user}` or 422 `{message, errors}` (an inactive account with the right password gets 422 `errors.email` "This account is deactivated." and no token, mis-5); `GET /api/mis/user` → 200 `{user}`; `POST /api/mis/logout` → 204, revokes only the current token. `user` = `UserResource` `{id, name, email, roles: string[]}`. No valid token → 401 `{"message":"Unauthenticated."}`; no staff role → 403 `{"message":"Unauthorized"}`.
- Entity `school_years` (mis-3, `SchoolYear`): `name` string unique, `start_date` / `end_date` date, `description` text nullable, `term_type` string `semester`|`trimester` default `semester` (mis-11; required on create/update; cannot change while the year has terms), `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active, at most one active row).
- School-year endpoints (mis-3, `SchoolYearController`): `school_year` = `SchoolYearResource` `{id, name, start_date, end_date, description, term_type, terms_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at}` (10 keys since mis-11; `terms_count` = number of terms, dates `Y-m-d`, timestamps ISO-8601). Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404; ids numeric (`whereNumber`), else route 404.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years` (admin, registrar since mis-13) → 200 `{school_years: [school_year]}`, all rows, `start_date` desc then `id` desc.
  - `POST /api/mis/school-years` (admin) JSON `{name, start_date, end_date, term_type, description?}` → 201 `{school_year}` (`is_active` false) or 422 `{message, errors}`. Rules: name required, max 255, unique; dates `date_format:Y-m-d`, `end_date` after `start_date`; description nullable, max 1000; `term_type` required, `semester`|`trimester`. `is_active` in the body is ignored.
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) same body (unique ignores own row) → 200 `{school_year}`, `is_active` unchanged; 422; 404 `{message}`. With terms (mis-11): 422 `errors.term_type` when the type changes; 422 `errors.start_date` / `errors.end_date` when the new dates would leave a term outside (inclusive). With payment plans (mis-16): 422 `errors.start_date` / `errors.end_date` when the new dates would leave an installment due date outside (inclusive, inactive plans count).
  - `DELETE /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) → 204; 422 `{"message":"The active school year cannot be deleted."}` for the active row; 404. Deleting an inactive year deletes its terms (FK cascade, mis-11). An inactive year with sections: 422 `{"message":"The school year has sections and cannot be deleted."}` (mis-12; the active-year message wins for the active row). An inactive year with fee schedules (mis-15): 422 `{"message":"The school year has fee schedules and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the sections guard). An inactive year with payment plans (mis-16): 422 `{"message":"The school year has payment plans and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the fee-schedules guard). An inactive year with student discounts (mis-17): 422 `{"message":"The school year has student discounts and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the payment-plans guard).
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/set-active/{id}` (admin) → 200 `{school_year}` (`is_active` true, all others false, and any active term of another year cleared, in one transaction with 3 attempts); 404 changes nothing.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years/get-active` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{school_year}` or `{"school_year": null}`.
- Entity `terms` (mis-11, `Term`): `school_year_id` FK (cascade on delete), `term_number` (1–2 for semester years, 1–3 for trimester years; unique per year), `start_date` / `end_date` date, `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active; at most one active term, always in the active school year). Label computed, never stored: `Term::buildLabel()` → "1st Semester", "2nd Semester", "1st Trimester", "2nd Trimester", "3rd Trimester". Date rules: end strictly after start; both dates inside the year (inclusive); vs every other term of the year, a higher number starts strictly after a lower number ends (so no overlap, not even one shared day); terms may be added in any order.
- Term endpoints (mis-11, `TermController`): `term` = `TermResource` `{id, school_year_id, term_number, label, start_date, end_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{terms: [term]}` by `term_number`, all rows; 404. `GET /api/mis/terms/get-active` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{term}` with nested `school_year`, or `{"term": null}`. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` JSON `{term_number, start_date, end_date}` → 201 `{term}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/{id}` same body → 200 `{term}`; `DELETE /api/mis/terms/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The active term cannot be deleted."}` or, for an inactive term with enrollments (mis-13), 422 `{"message":"The term has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/set-active/{id}` (body-less) → 200 `{term}` (one transaction, 3 attempts), 422 `{"message":"Only a term of the active school year can be set active."}`. Write routes resolve the year/term before validation: 401 → 403 → 404 → 422. No deactivate route.
- Entity `students` (mis-4, `Student`): `lrn` string(12) unique (exactly 12 digits, validated); required `first_name`, `last_name`, `birth_date` (date, before today), `gender` (`Student::GENDERS`), `guardian_name`, `guardian_relationship`, `guardian_contact` (max 20); nullable `middle_name`, `address`, `contact` (max 20); `rfid` nullable unique and `user_id` nullable unique FK to `users` (null on delete) are not fillable and never written by the student endpoints.
- Student endpoints (mis-4, `StudentController`, staff group: admin and registrar): `student` = `StudentResource` (16 keys since mis-13, `birth_date` `Y-m-d`, `rfid` string or null, `current_enrollment` `{id, section_id, term_id, section {id, name}, grade_level {id, name, stage}}` or null, no `user_id`; `grade_level`/`section` were dropped, a student's level now comes from its current enrollment: enrolled row in a section of the active school year, whole-year or of the active term, highest id wins). `GET /api/mis/students?search=&grade_level_id=&page=` → 200 `{students: [student], meta: {current_page, last_page, per_page, total}}`, 15 per page, `created_at` desc then `id` desc, search = every whitespace-split word in lrn/first/middle/last name (case-insensitive), no `per_page` param. `POST /api/mis/students` → 201 `{student}`; `PUT /api/mis/students/{id}` → 200 `{student}` (LRN unique ignores own row); `DELETE /api/mis/students/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The student has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}` when it has any enrollment. A student with discounts (mis-17): 422 `{"message":"The student has discounts and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the enrollments guard). 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`; `rfid`/`user_id` in a body are ignored. Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entity `users` as employees (mis-5): adds `contact` string(20) nullable (fillable, max 20) and `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). Inactive users cannot log in and hold no tokens.
- Employee endpoints (mis-5, `EmployeeController`, admin group): `employee` = `EmployeeResource` `{id, name, email, contact, is_active, roles: string[], created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/employees?search=&role=&status=&page=` → 200 `{employees: [employee], meta}`, 15 per page, newest first, search = every word in name/email, `role` admin|registrar, `status` active|inactive. `POST /api/mis/employees` → 201 `{employee}` (password min 8 confirmed, roles ≥ 1 of admin/registrar). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}` → 200 `{employee}` (no password). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/password` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens. `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/deactivate` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens; `/reactivate` → 200 `{employee}`. Safeguards (422): no self-deactivate, no removing your own admin role, the last active admin cannot be deactivated or lose admin. Search/page meta shared via `Concerns\SearchesPaginatedLists`.
- Entity `grade_levels` (mis-10, `GradeLevel`): `name` string unique, `sort_order` unique (1–10), `stage` `jhs`|`shs`|`college` (`GradeLevel::STAGES`; programs use `GradeLevel::PROGRAM_STAGES` = shs, college). Exactly 10 fixed rows (Grade 7–10 jhs, Grade 11–12 shs, 1st–4th Year College college; names Grade 7–10, Grade 11–12, 1st–4th Year College) inserted by the create migration itself, so they exist after `migrate` and in every test without `db:seed`. No write endpoints.
- Entity `programs` (mis-10, `Program`): `code` string(20) unique, stored upper-case (trimmed + upper-cased before validation, so uniqueness ignores case); required `name` (max 255) and `stage` (`shs`|`college`); `description` text nullable (max 1000); `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). A program covers every grade level of its stage (shared stage value, no relation). The demo seeder adds STEM, ABM, HUMSS, GAS, TVL (shs) and BSIT, BSCS, BSBA (college) once each, keyed on code.
- Grade-level and program endpoints (mis-10, `GradeLevelController`, `ProgramController`): `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{grade_levels: [{id, name, stage, sort_order}]}`, all 10 by `sort_order`. `program` = `ProgramResource` `{id, code, name, stage, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/programs?search=&stage=&status=&page=` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{programs: [program], meta}`, 15 per page, `code` asc, search = every word in code/name, `stage` shs|college, `status` active|inactive, inactive rows listed by default. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/programs` → 201 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 200 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}/deactivate` and `/reactivate` → 200 `{program}` (body-less, idempotent); `DELETE /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 204 (hard delete); 422 `{"message":"The program has sections and cannot be deleted."}` when sections use it (mis-12), or 422 `{"message":"The program has fee schedules and cannot be deleted."}` when fee schedules use it (mis-15, checked after the sections guard). 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`.
- Entity `sections` (mis-12, `Section`): `school_year_id` FK, `grade_level_id` FK, `program_id` FK nullable (all three restrict on delete), `name` string (max 255, trimmed, case kept), `capacity` unsigned integer (1–2147483647), `room` string nullable (max 255). A section lasts the whole school year (no term); its enrolled count is computed per request (mis-13). Program rules by the grade level's stage: JHS no program, SHS an SHS program, college a college program; an inactive program is rejected on create and when the program changes, kept when unchanged. Name unique ignoring case within school year + grade level + program, with "no program" one group; enforced by `StoreSectionRequest` (`LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`), no unique index. Ids and capacity accept JSON numbers or digit strings without leading zeros.
- Section endpoints (mis-12, `SectionController`): `section` = `SectionResource` `{id, school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id, name, capacity, room, created_at, updated_at, grade_level: {id, name, stage}, program: {id, code, name} | null}`. `GET /api/mis/sections?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=&search=&page=` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{sections: [section], meta}`, 15 per page, `school_year_id` required (422), ordered grade level `sort_order` → program code → name, search = every word in name. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/sections` → 201 `{section}`; `PUT /api/mis/sections/{id}` (full body, every field editable) → 200 `{section}`; `DELETE /api/mis/sections/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The section has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}` when it has any enrollment (mis-13). `enrolled_count` = enrolled rows of the section; with `term_id` it counts that term plus whole-year (JHS) rows, without it every enrolled row. Once a section has enrollments (any status) its `school_year_id`, `grade_level_id` and `program_id` cannot change and `capacity` cannot drop below the largest per-term enrolled count (422 `errors.<field>`). 422 `{message, errors}` (`program_id` for stage/inactive rules, `name` for uniqueness); 404 `{message}`. Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entity `enrollments` (mis-13, `Enrollment`): `student_id`, `section_id` (FK restrict), `term_id` nullable (FK restrict; null for a JHS section, required for SHS/college and must belong to the section's school year), `status` (`Enrollment::STATUSES`: `enrolled`, `moved`, `dropped`, `transferred`, `completed`), `enrolled_at` date, `ended_at` date nullable (null while `enrolled`), `remarks` text nullable (max 1000). No unique index: "at most one `enrolled` row per student and period" (a JHS year row collides with any row of that school year, across stages) and the hard capacity limit (enrolled rows of the section and the same `term_id`, closed rows and other terms not counted) are checked in `EnrollmentController` under row locks (the overlap rule is `Enrollment::scopeInPeriodOf`, shared with the rollover) (student, enrollment, then section, in one transaction with 3 attempts). Status changes only from `enrolled`; there is no update or delete endpoint.
- Enrollment endpoints (mis-13, `EnrollmentController`, staff group: admin and registrar): `enrollment` = `EnrollmentResource` `{id, student_id, section_id, term_id, status, enrolled_at, ended_at, remarks, created_at, updated_at, student {id, lrn, first_name, middle_name, last_name}, section {id, name, grade_level {id, name, stage}, program {id, code} | null}, term {id, term_number, label} | null}`. `GET /api/mis/enrollments?school_year_id=&term_id=&section_id=&grade_level_id=&status=&search=&page=` → 200 `{enrollments, meta}`, 15 per page, `school_year_id` required, ordered last name → first name → id, `term_id` keeps the year's JHS rows, search = every word in lrn/first/middle/last name. `POST /api/mis/enrollments` `{student_id, section_id, term_id?, enrolled_at?, remarks?}` → 201 `{enrollment}` (`enrolled_at` defaults to today); 422 `errors.term_id` (JHS with a term / term missing / term of another year), `errors.student_id` "The student is already enrolled for this period.", `errors.section_id` "The section is full for this period.". `PUT /api/mis/enrollments/{id}/move` `{section_id, ended_at?, remarks?}` → 200 `{enrollment}` = the new row (same term, same school year and grade level as the source, program may differ; the source becomes `moved`); `PUT .../{id}/drop|transfer|complete` `{ended_at?, remarks?}` → 200 `{enrollment}`. `ended_at` defaults to today and may equal but not precede `enrolled_at` (`errors.ended_at`). A non-`enrolled` row gives 422 `{"message":"Only an enrolled record can be changed."}`. Precedence on `{id}` routes: 401 → 403 → 422 (body) → 404 → 422 (closed) → 422 (fields).
- Section rollover endpoints (mis-14, `SectionRolloverController`, staff group, no migration): the next term is the term of the same year with `term_number + 1` (`Term::findNextTerm()`; `Term::isLastTerm()` = number at or above `SchoolYear::TERM_COUNTS`). `GET /api/mis/sections/{id}/rollover-preview?term_id=` -> 200 `{target_term: {id, term_number, label}|null, seats_left: int|null, enrollments: [row]}` (row = `EnrollmentResource` plus `is_enrolled_in_target` and `skip_reason`, 15 keys, not paginated, last name -> first name -> id); `target_term` and `seats_left` are null when the term is the last or its next term is missing; seats left = capacity minus enrolled rows of the section in the next term. `POST /api/mis/sections/{id}/rollover` `{term_id, enrollment_ids: int[] (>=1, distinct), ended_at?, remarks?}` -> 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [row]}`: in one transaction (3 attempts, lock order student -> enrollment -> section, each batch sorted by id) each selected `enrolled` record becomes `completed` (`ended_at` defaults to today) and an `enrolled` record is opened in the same section for the next term (`enrolled_at` = `ended_at`); students already enrolled in the next term are skipped and reported, their source stays `enrolled`. Whole-batch 422s: `errors.term_id` (JHS section, term of another year, last term, next term missing), `errors.enrollment_ids` (missing, closed, other-section or other-term id), `errors.ended_at` (before an enrolled date of a record to copy), `errors.section_id` (to-copy count above seats left). `PUT /api/mis/sections/{id}/complete` `{term_id?, ended_at?, remarks?}` -> 200 `{completed_count}` closes every `enrolled` record of the section as `completed`: per term for SHS/college (`term_id` required), the whole year for JHS (`term_id` forbidden); zero rows is 200 with 0. Precedence: rollover 401 -> 403 -> 422 (body, JHS, year) -> 404 -> 422 (term, selection, date, seats); preview 401 -> 403 -> 422 -> 404; complete 401 -> 403 -> 422 -> 404 -> 422 (`ended_at`).
- Entity `fee_items` (mis-15, `FeeItem`): `name` string (max 255, trimmed, unique ignoring case; enforced by `StoreFeeItemRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, no unique index), `category` string (`FeeItem::CATEGORIES`: `tuition`, `miscellaneous`, `other`), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). There is no delete endpoint; the restrict FK from `fee_schedule_lines` also protects a used item.
- Entities `fee_schedules` + `fee_schedule_lines` (mis-15, `FeeSchedule`, `FeeScheduleLine`): a schedule is keyed by `school_year_id`, `grade_level_id` (FK restrict) and nullable `program_id` (FK restrict; null = the grade level's default); JHS and SHS grade levels only (`FeeSchedule::BILLABLE_STAGES`, college later). JHS takes no program; an SHS program must be SHS and active. Each key exists once, with "no program" its own value; enforced by `StoreFeeScheduleRequest` and, under a lock on the school year row inside a transaction (3 attempts), again by the create and copy controllers (no unique index). `fee_schedule_lines`: `fee_schedule_id` (FK cascade), `fee_item_id` (FK restrict), `amount` decimal(12,2) > 0 with at most two decimals, unique per schedule and item. Money is exact: totals use `Brick\Math\BigDecimal` and every amount, `total` and subtotal is a 2-decimal string. Keys are locked after create. `FeeSchedule::findEffective()` (program schedule, else the default, else null) is the in-process lookup MIS-18 uses.
- Fee endpoints (mis-15, `FeeItemController`, `FeeScheduleController`, `FeeScheduleCopyController`, admin group only: registrar 403, guest 401): `fee_item` = `FeeItemResource` `{id, name, category, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`; `fee_schedule` = `FeeScheduleResource` `{id, school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id, created_at, updated_at, grade_level {id, name, stage}, program {id, code, name} | null, lines_count, total, subtotals {tuition, miscellaneous, other}}`; the detail (`FeeScheduleDetailResource`) adds `lines: [{id, fee_item_id, amount, fee_item {id, name, category, is_active}}]`. `GET /api/mis/fee-items?search=&category=&status=&page=` → 200 `{fee_items, meta}` (15 per page, `name` then `id`, inactive listed by default); `POST /api/mis/fee-items` `{name, category, description?}` → 201 `{fee_item}` (422 `errors.name` "The name has already been taken."); `PUT /api/mis/fee-items/{id}` → 200 (`is_active` unchanged); `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200. `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=<id>|none&page=` → 200 `{fee_schedules, meta}` (`school_year_id` required; grade level order, default first, then program code; 15 per page); `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` → 200 `{fee_schedule: detail}`; `POST /api/mis/fee-schedules` `{school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id|null, lines: [{fee_item_id, amount}]}` → 201 detail (lines: at least one, active item, each item once, amount > 0 with at most two decimals up to 9999999999.99; 422 `errors.grade_level_id` for a college level or a taken key, `errors.program_id` for the program rules); `PUT /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` `{lines}` → 200 detail, lines replaced as a set in one transaction; a key field sent with another value → 422 `errors.<field>` "This field cannot change once the fee schedule exists."; an inactive item stays only on an unchanged line (same amount); `DELETE /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` → 204 (lines cascade); `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules/lookup?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=` → 200 `{fee_schedule: detail | null}`; `POST /api/mis/fee-schedules/copy` `{source_school_year_id, target_school_year_id}` → 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [{grade_level, program, reason}]}` (one transaction; skips a key that already exists in the target, an inactive program, or a schedule left with no active item, dropping inactive-item lines otherwise; 422 `errors.target_school_year_id` for the same year). Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entities `payment_plans` + `payment_plan_installments` (mis-16, `PaymentPlan`, `PaymentPlanInstallment`): a plan belongs to a school year (`school_year_id`, FK restrict, locked after create) and has `name` (max 100, trimmed, unique per year ignoring case; enforced by `StorePaymentPlanRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)` and again under a lock on the school year row in a transaction with 3 attempts by the create, update and copy controllers; no unique index), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `is_active` (default true, not fillable; only deactivate/reactivate change it), a down payment (`down_payment_type` `fixed`|`percent`, `down_payment_value` decimal(12,2)) and an optional tuition-only adjustment (`adjustment_kind` `discount`|`surcharge`, `adjustment_type`, `adjustment_value`). Values are > 0 with at most two decimals; fixed up to 9999999999.99, a percent down payment < 100, a percent adjustment <= 100. `payment_plan_installments`: `payment_plan_id` (FK cascade), `sequence` (1..12), `due_date`, unique per plan on sequence and on date. A plan has 0 to 12 due dates (`due_dates` list; none = a "Cash" plan), distinct, strictly increasing and inside the school year (inclusive); an update replaces them as a set. A down payment is required with installments and refused without; a discount is allowed only on a Cash plan and a surcharge only on an installment plan. Money stays a 2-decimal string. MIS-18 reads `PaymentPlan::isCash()` and `PaymentPlan::ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY` (`tuition`) in-process.
- Payment plan endpoints (mis-16, `PaymentPlanController`, `PaymentPlanCopyController`, admin group only: registrar 403, guest 401): `payment_plan` = `PaymentPlanResource` `{id, school_year_id, name, description, is_active, installments_count, installments: [{sequence, due_date}], down_payment {type, value} | null, adjustment {kind, type, value, category} | null, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/payment-plans?school_year_id=&search=&status=&page=` → 200 `{payment_plans, meta}` (`school_year_id` required, `name` then `id`, 15 per page, inactive listed by default); `GET /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` → 200 `{payment_plan}`; `POST /api/mis/payment-plans` `{school_year_id, name, description?, due_dates: [Y-m-d], down_payment: {type, value} | null, adjustment: {kind, type, value} | null}` → 201 (422 keys `name`, `due_dates`, `due_dates.N`, `down_payment`, `down_payment.type|value`, `adjustment`, `adjustment.kind|type|value`); `PUT /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` same body, `school_year_id` optional and, if sent, must equal the stored one (422 `errors.school_year_id`), installments replaced, `is_active` unchanged → 200; `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` → 204 (installments cascade; MIS-18 adds the used-by-assessment guard); `POST /api/mis/payment-plans/copy` `{source_school_year_id, target_school_year_id}` → 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [{name, reason}]}` (one transaction; due dates move by the whole-year difference with no overflow, so Feb 29 becomes Feb 28 when the target year has no Feb 29 and stays Feb 29 when it has; skips a name that already exists in the target (ignoring case) or a moved date outside the target year; 422 `errors.target_school_year_id` for the same year). Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entities `discount_types` + `student_discounts` (mis-17, `DiscountType`, `StudentDiscount`): `discount_types` is a global catalog (no school year): `name` string(100) (unique ignoring case, enforced by `StoreDiscountTypeRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, no unique index, no locked re-check), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `source` `government`|`school`, `value_type` `fixed`|`percent`, `value` decimal(12,2) > 0 with at most two decimals (fixed up to 9999999999.99, percent up to 100, cast `decimal:2`), `base` `tuition`|`total`, `stages` json (cast `array`, stored in canonical order `jhs`, `shs`; non-empty, `college` refused, never queried in SQL), `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). While students hold a type its `source` cannot change and no stage can be removed (adding a stage and changing name, description, value type, value and base stay allowed; inactive types stay editable). `student_discounts`: `student_id`, `school_year_id`, `discount_type_id` (all FK restrict), `reference_no` string(50) nullable, `remarks` string(500) nullable, unique (`student_id`, `school_year_id`, `discount_type_id`, index `student_discounts_assignment_unique`). An assignment needs an active type, an `enrolled` or `completed` enrollment of the student in that school year whose grade-level stage the type allows (`StudentDiscount::findEnrolledStages()`), at most one assignment per type and at most one `government` type per student per year (re-checked under a lock on the student row in a transaction with 3 attempts); held rows count whatever their type's `is_active`. Update changes only `reference_no` and `remarks`; delete is always allowed. Stacking rule for MIS-18: every discount is computed on the gross amount of its base, the discounts are summed, and the total discount is capped so no category goes below ₱0.
- Discount endpoints (mis-17, `DiscountTypeController`, `StudentDiscountController`, admin group only: registrar 403, guest 401): `discount_type` = `DiscountTypeResource` `{id, name, description, source, value_type, value, base, stages, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`; `student_discount` = `StudentDiscountResource` `{id, student_id, school_year_id, discount_type_id, reference_no, remarks, created_at, updated_at, student {id, lrn, first_name, middle_name, last_name}, grade_level {id, name, stage} | null, discount_type {id, name, source, value_type, value, base, is_active}}` (`grade_level` = the student's latest enrollment in that row's year). `GET /api/mis/discount-types?search=&source=&status=&page=` → 200 `{discount_types, meta}` (15 per page, `name` then `id`, inactive listed by default); `GET /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` → 200 `{discount_type}`; `POST /api/mis/discount-types` `{name, description?, source, value_type, value, base, stages: ["jhs"|"shs"]}` → 201 (422 `errors.name`, `description`, `source`, `value_type`, `value`, `base`, `stages`, `stages.N` including "Discount types are only for junior and senior high school." for `college`); `PUT /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` same body → 200 (`is_active` unchanged; held type: 422 `errors.source` "The source cannot change while students hold this discount type." / `errors.stages` "A stage cannot be removed while students hold this discount type."); `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The discount type is held by students and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead."}` while any student holds it. `GET /api/mis/student-discounts?school_year_id=&search=&discount_type_id=&source=&student_id=&page=` → 200 `{student_discounts, meta}` (`school_year_id` required, student last name → first name → id, 15 per page); `POST /api/mis/student-discounts` `{student_id, school_year_id, discount_type_id, reference_no?, remarks?}` → 201 (422 `errors.student_id` not enrolled, `errors.discount_type_id` first failure of inactive / stage not allowed / already held / government limit); `PUT /api/mis/student-discounts/{id}` `{reference_no?, remarks?}` (other keys ignored) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/student-discounts/{id}` → 204 (MIS-18 adds the used-by-assessment guard). Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Roles: `roles` + `role_user` pivot (many-to-many); names are `Role::ADMIN` / `Role::REGISTRAR` constants (`Role::STAFF_ROLES`). `User::hasAnyRole()` is the role check.
- Middleware: `role:` alias → `RoleMiddleware` (any-match, 403 `{message}`); `ForceJsonResponse` prepended to the api group in `bootstrap/app.php` (built in mis-1).
- Errors are always JSON; validation via FormRequest or `$request->validate()`; list endpoints `paginate()`, except `GET /api/mis/school-years` (all rows, decided mis-3 AMBIGUITY-5); the students list pages 15 per page under a `meta` key (mis-4); the employees list does the same (mis-5), and so does the programs list (mis-10), the sections list (mis-12) the enrollments list (mis-13), the fee items and fee schedules lists (mis-15), the payment plans list (mis-16), and the discount types and student discounts lists (mis-17); `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` returns all rows (mis-10).

## Work Guidance

- Run: `php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000` · Test: `php artisan test` · Lint: `./vendor/bin/pint`
- Ports: 8000
- Migrate `php artisan migrate` · routes `php artisan route:list` · full dev stack `composer run dev` · first-time setup `composer run setup`
- Create files with `php artisan make:*`; controllers stay thin; no logic in route closures; config via `config()`, never `env()` outside `config/`.
- Every new endpoint gets a Feature test (success + validation failure). Scanner endpoints are tested with the firmware encoding and no Accept header. Avoid Postgres-only SQL (tests run on SQLite).
- `db:seed` needs `SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env` (read via `config('auth.seed_admin.*')`); seeds roles + one admin, the demo programs and six demo discount types (placeholder values, mis-17); idempotent.
- Keep Laravel's unused frontend scaffolding (`resources/`, `vite.config.js`, `package.json`, `welcome` view).

## Verification

- `php artisan test` passes
- `be-auditor` passes on staged changes before commit

## Child DOX Index

- `app/` — models (`Models/`), HTTP controllers/requests/resources (`Http/`), middleware (`Http/Middleware`), providers
- `bootstrap/app.php` — routing (web, api, `/up`), middleware, exception hooks
- `config/` — framework config, including `sanctum.php`
- `database/` — migrations, factories, seeders
- `routes/` — `api.php` (all API routes), `web.php`, `console.php`
- `tests/` — `Feature/` (HTTP endpoints), `Unit/` (pure logic)
- `resources/`, `public/` — unused frontend scaffolding / entry point

# DOX framework

AGENTS.md files are binding work contracts for their subtrees. Before editing, read this file plus every AGENTS.md on the path to each file you'll touch; the nearest one is the local contract. After a meaningful change, update the closest owning AGENTS.md if purpose, structure, contracts, routes, entities, or workflows changed, and remove stale text. Create a child AGENTS.md when a folder becomes a durable boundary. Child sections: Purpose · Ownership · Local Contracts · Work Guidance · Verification · Child DOX Index.
